name: How long do fall prevention home modification projects usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long do fall prevention home modification projects usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of fall prevention home modification projects varies significantly based on their complexity. Simple installations, such as adding grab bars or handrails, might be completed within a day. More extensive projects, like a full bathroom accessibility remodel or the construction of an exterior ramp, could take several days to a few weeks, sometimes longer if permits are involved. We provide an estimated timeline with your project proposal after understanding the full scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: simple modifications can take a day, while extensive remodels may take several days to weeks, depending on complexity and permits.
